captures.title: Select the supplied Sentinel-2 scene in Planetary Computer

focus.text: Use the supplied scene ID and June 29 acquisition date. The analysis period still ends August 31.

captures.title: Use original scientific bands, not the RGB preview

focus.text: B04 is an original red-band GeoTIFF. The other required keys are B08, B11, B12 and SCL.
The displayed natural-colour image is for inspection only; it cannot replace the five bands.

captures.title: Download metadata and all five original TIFFs

focus.text: Download item.json first. It identifies the scene and original grids.
Download B04, B08, B11 and B12. Keep the original filenames.
Download SCL too. Wait for all six transfers in the browser's Downloads list.

captures.title: Upload the original files into your scene folder

focus.text: Open the scene folder's More options menu, then Upload.
Choose Upload files. Do not choose Load to Tables.

captures.title: Verify all six inputs before starting Lab 01

focus.text: The folder must show six completed files: five TIFFs and one JSON.
item.json belongs beside the TIFFs, not in a different folder.
